In the US at least you will need to remove shoes, empty your pockets, they will have bins to place your cellphone, keys, wallet and shoes into. Remove your belt as the metal in the buckle will often set off the metal detector. Don't pack things like toothpaste or other liquids or gels in your carry on in amounts over 3.4 oz. Once through security collect all your stuff and head to your boarding gate. Once there you will probably be waiting awhile until the start boarding the plane.
